revision_summary: Two targeted fixes needed on rerun: (1) Timestamp correction — the quote 'is that the main reason you're interested in solar?' is misattributed to 00:59 in both rep_intent.evidence[1] and script_coverage[1].interest_question; it actually occurs at the tail end of the [00:37] transcript block, immediately preceding the customer's 00:59 response. Update both instances to ts 00:37 (or note it as the closing line of that turn). (2) Reclassify the 02:56 husband/military moment in cherry_pick_moments: it is currently tagged 'cross_sell_miss' with schema_reference 'protocols.hello_objection_not_interested', neither of which fits the content. This is a title/co-decision-maker ambiguity (husband mentioned in household after customer confirmed sole title ownership), not a cross-sell signal, and has nothing to do with a first-30-seconds 'not interested' objection. Reclassify against protocols.spouse_decision or verify.title_co_owners. Additionally, the setter_scope_creep-labeled entry at 03:03 should carry a classification label consistent with its own conclusion (the rep held scope correctly) rather than a label implying creep occurred — consider relabeling to something like 'scope_discipline_held' to avoid confusing a manager scanning tags. Optionally strengthen the missed flip-opportunity moment at ~00:56 ('gas... it's expensive') as a concrete objection_inversion trigger per schema's own example list. These are precise, bounded fixes; the rest of the analysis (trajectory verdict, bill anchor audit, handoff brief, booked outcome call) is well-grounded and needs no change.
